do.text: Name two or more series in a legend, and give one a texture so it reads apart without colour.

dont.text: Don't rely on two close colours with no legend: colour-blind readers, and everyone else, have to guess.

do.text: Show a dozen categories at most (months, quarters), so every bar can be tapped and labelled.

dont.text: Don't squeeze a hundred bars into a phone's width: group them by month, or use a line.
